page_title: Qwen2.5: A Party of Foundation Models!

summary.name: Qwen2.5
summary.one_liner: Qwen2.5 is Alibaba's Qwen team's family of open-weight dense decoder-only language models (plus Qwen2.5-Coder and Qwen2.5-Math specialist models), released September 2024.
use_cases: run an open-weight LLM locally or on own servers
serve an OpenAI-compatible API with vLLM
add tool calling to an application
summary.what_it_does: The page announces Qwen2.5 LLMs in sizes from 0.5B to 72B parameters, plus Qwen2.5-Coder for coding (trained on 5.5 trillion code tokens) and Qwen2.5-Math for mathematics, which supports Chinese and English and CoT, PoT and TIR reasoning. Base models are pretrained on up to 18 trillion tokens and support up to 128K context and 8K generated tokens, with multilingual support for over 29 languages. It shows a Hugging Face Transformers example, vLLM OpenAI-compatible serving, and tool calling via vLLM, Ollama and transformers. Benchmarks compare Qwen2.5-72B against Llama-3.1-70B, Mistral-Large-V2 and Llama-3-405B, and Qwen-Plus and Qwen-Turbo API models against GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet.
notable: Most models are Apache 2.0 licensed; the 3B and 72B variants are not
Qwen2.5-72B benchmarked against Llama-3.1-70B and Mistral-Large-V2
Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-Math variants for coding and math
Tool calling uses a template inspired by Nous' Hermes
caveats: The 3B and 72B open models are not Apache 2.0 licensed (license terms not detailed on the page)
Qwen2.5-Coder 1.5B, 7B and 32B were listed as 'on the way' at the time of writing
Qwen-Plus and Qwen-Turbo are API-only models accessed through Model Studio, not open weights
Technical report was described as forthcoming; the page cites the Qwen2 paper in the meantime
